title: Static-asset versioning: existing pages still need old assets
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Load old HTML after deployment; detect asset retirement that breaks an existing page.
sourceAcceptance: Existing pages resolve required assets correctly; early asset removal produces a visible failing result.
preconditions: Local browser HTML, CSS and JavaScript; no account, server or installation for the lesson.
Cached HTML v1 requires app.a17c.js and site.a17c.css.
Published HTML v2 requires distinct app.b28d.js and site.b28d.css.
Fixed synthetic immutable identifiers are never rewritten to new contents.
Every attempt plans two page loads and four required asset observations.
actions: Choose complete or withheld-old-script observation, and the optional retirement target.
Cache HTML v1 and deploy v2; optionally retire the old script or both old assets.
Load cached HTML v1 after deployment, then load current HTML v2 for comparison.
Inspect synthetic 200/404/unobserved asset results, page outcomes and the fixed denominator.
Check a prediction, retain completed attempts for comparison, or explicitly reset all defaults and history.
syntheticInput: learning/S057/model.js: four fixed immutable asset identifiers; all page and asset data are synthetic.
assertions: Retained old assets resolve for cached old HTML after v2 publication.
Early old-script or stylesheet retirement visibly fails the required old-page journey.
Successful current HTML never erases a failed old page.
Withheld and pending observations remain unknown; a known failure dominates uncertainty.
Both page loads and four observed successes are required for overall synthetic success.
Exact configuration, event-order and replayed-state guards reject invalid commands without mutation.
At most six completed attempts are retained without implicit pruning; reset is explicit and keyboard accessible.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine loadable-stub assertion RED and before implementation.
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson; no infrastructure, cloud or deployment authorized.

limits: In-memory deterministic resolver, not actual asset HTTP responses, downloaded bundles, browser caching, CDN propagation or native retirement proof.
Identifiers model immutable versioned names; they do not certify real content hashes or cache headers.
No latency, native-platform, source-parent or five-nines certification.
No authentication, credentials, registration, management calls, cloud, IaC, scaffold, deployment or spending.
History lasts until explicit reset or page reload and is never silently pruned.
B-S057 and D-S057 remain incomplete; one frozen S unit, no credit for tests, plumbing or refinement.
Published browser helper only; its known unattended lifecycle limitation remains, with awaited finally cleanup used here.
